name: New York, the Bronx
living: an elevated subway train glides slowly across the tracks behind the outfield, its windows glowing
the red aircraft-warning light on the tall spire blinks slowly and its crown lights glow
Manhattan skyline windows flicker on one by one in the pastel dusk
the heart BRONX sign glows with a soft neon buzz and a rare flicker
the small flags on the light towers wave gently
pink and lavender pixel clouds drift slowly across the sky
light-tower lamp banks breathe softly, dust motes drifting through the cones
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
